assets.name: zavtoo-seaglass
assets.prompt: Use case: ads-marketing. Create ONE completely redesigned premium water-purifier campaign image for the Zavtoo website. The supplied image is a reference for the general type of purifier only; redesign the composition, branding, backdrop, lighting and graphic treatment from scratch. Cohesive campaign art direction: photorealistic luxury appliance photography / high-end 3D product render, restrained aqua and white with deep teal #005061, mint #e2f8f2, clean generous negative space, soft watery reflections, realistic materials and subtle chrome detailing. Output a portrait 4:5 image, product fully visible and dominant, elegant clean commercial quality. The ONLY company or brand name anywhere in the entire image MUST be exactly 'Zavtoo' (Z-a-v-t-o-o). Put a refined readable 'Zavtoo' wordmark at top and a small Zavtoo mark on the appliance. Remove every original brand, logo, domain, watermark, label, seal and slogan. No other company names, model names, URLs, numerical specifications, performance claims, prices, certification badges or additional text. No collage grid of multiple posters; this is one individual campaign visual. Design 1, SEA GLASS: an elegant light sea-glass blue wall-mounted home purifier with a translucent vertically ribbed tank, brushed chrome tap and minimal graphite control strip. Front three-quarter product shot on a pale ivory stone plinth, airy off-white and mint studio backdrop with a very soft water-caustic pattern, morning window light, delicate product shadow. Brand title in deep teal, visually distinct from the original crowded ad, simple and premium.
